recognize_zh: 左側為成片的大型細胞，細胞質豐富偏雙染性、核偏心、染色質空泡狀並有明顯核仁，呈漿母細胞/免疫母細胞樣，界線清楚；右側對照為小型成熟淋巴球，大小差異明顯，符合 PEL 的細胞型態。
features: Sheet of large cells, several times the size of adjacent small lymphocytes
Abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with vesicular chromatin and prominent central or multiple nucleoli
Plasmablastic/immunoblastic cytology with occasional binucleated cells and mitoses
Scattered apoptotic bodies and small lymphocytes within the tumor sheet
Adjacent small mature lymphocyte population on the right
describe_en: H&E section at high power shows a cohesive sheet of large neoplastic cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders. The nuclei are round to oval and often eccentric, with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, giving an immunoblastic to plasmablastic appearance; occasional binucleated forms, mitoses and apoptotic bodies are present. A population of small mature lymphocytes lies to the right for comparison. Findings are consistent with a high-grade large-cell lymphoma with plasmablastic features; in the context of HHV8 positivity, they are consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cytologically near-identical; separated by HHV8 (LANA-1) negativity.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic plasma cell myeloma / plasmablastic myeloma
ddx.vs: Shares plasmacytic cytology but is HHV8-negative, usually expresses CD138 with clonal light chain and has serum paraprotein and lytic lesions.
Hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and strong CD30 with ALK or T-cell markers, HHV8-negative.
Cohesive polygonal cells may mimic this; cytokeratin positivity and CD45/MUM1 negativity distinguish it.
